evidence_paraphrase: The FY2020 issuer filing describes the transfer of the same KDMN common stock from NYSE, effective after trading October 23, 2020, to Nasdaq, where trading actually commenced October 26. The October 13 issuer release says KDMN is retained. The original September 2021 proxy separately reports the same common stock's historical trading range over the 52 weeks ending September 2, 2021, covering September 30-December 30, 2020. The exchange changes within the reviewed security interval.
exchange_segment_note: October 24-25 were the intervening weekend; the filing describes a listing transfer of the same common stock, not a security replacement. Nasdaq remains the exchange at cohort entry and observation.

historical_exchange_segments.end_basis: Close of trading on October 23 per issuer disclosure; no exact acceptance or execution timestamp asserted.

historical_exchange_segments.start_basis: Actual trading commencement stated in FY2020 Item 5.

limitations: Actual review and capture occurred in September 2026; this is retrospective identity adjudication, not a contemporaneous archived review.
